Eva is a Postdoc working on soil respiration with land surface models and on continental-scale ecosystem dynamics using satellite-based solar-induced fluorescence (SIF).


## Education

- [PhD in Physics]{.fw-bold} | Heidelberg University, Germany | 2021 -  2025
- [MS in Physics]{.fw-bold} | Heidelberg University, Germany | 2019 -  2021
- [BS in Physics]{.fw-bold} | University of Marburg, Germany | 2015 -  2019
- [BS in Geography]{.fw-bold} | University of Marburg, Germany | 2015 -  2018
